title: Synthesis and multifaceted exploration of dibenzoxepinones: in vitro antimicrobial and ct-DNA binding, DFT/TD-DFT, molecular docking and simulation studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18089-18107
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01068C, Paper
Open Access

Shilpa Yadav, Mansi, Priyanshu, Pratibha Chanana, Pankaj Khanna, Asmita Singh, Leena Khanna
In the present study, ten novel derivatives of dibenzoxepine-11-one, have been synthesized and thoroughly characterized using spectroscopic techniques, including 1H and 13C NMR, FTIR, and HRMS.
